verdict.rationale: Firebase documents a managed, serverless datastore (Cloud Firestore and Realtime Database) that apps read, write, listen to and query directly, including offline. Server-side access is shown through the MongoDB-compatible API, which works with existing drivers (Enterprise edition), and through the CLI's data interaction. Community reports confirm fast multi-client syncing in real apps. Missing for 10: an explicit database-provisioning workflow, explicit docs on server/Admin SDK read/write (the Admin SDK is mentioned only as a Functions trigger), and well-rounded query depth (users report weak server-side querying and no count queries).
